sql: WITH scores AS (SELECT name,version,step,MAX(CASE WHEN model<>'Stack' THEN test_score END) baseline,MAX(CASE WHEN model='Stack' THEN test_score END) stack_score FROM model_score GROUP BY name,version,step) SELECT m.L1_model,COUNT(*) n,COUNT(DISTINCT m.name||':'||m.version||':'||m.step) model_steps,SUM(m.step<>s.step) cross_step_rows,SUM(stack_score>=baseline) noninferior_rows FROM model m JOIN scores s USING(name,version) WHERE baseline IS NOT NULL AND stack_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.L1_model
